description: This file contains unit tests for the CompanyStructureService class within the OrangeHRM Admin plugin, focusing on CRUD operations and hierarchical chain retrieval of Subunit entities.

classes.name: CompanyStructureServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for CompanyStructureService, testing methods for subunit retrieval, creation, deletion, hierarchy, and organization name setting.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture, setting up the CompanyStructureService instance and populating test data.

methods.name: testGetSubunitById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a Subunit by ID.

methods.name: testAddSubunit
methods.description: Tests adding a new Subunit under a parent Subunit.

methods.name: testSetOrganizationName
methods.description: Tests setting the organization name via the DAO.

methods.name: testGetSubunitTreeObject
methods.description: Tests retrieving the entire Subunit tree.

methods.name: testGetSubunitChainById
methods.description: Tests retrieving the hierarchy chain of Subunit IDs for a given Subunit, including complex nested structures.
